## RINL VS SAIL
Particulars RINL Vizag (2023-24) SAIL (2023-24)
Amount (Cr.) % of revenue Amount (Cr.) % of revenue
Revenue from operations 23,186.39 1,05,378.33
Cost of materials consumed 16,770.63 72.3% 57,709.26 54.8%
Coal cost 10,490.43 45.2% 45,918.51 43.6%
Iron ore cost 4,308.00 18.6% 10,324.00 9.8%
Employee benefit expenses 2,605.19 11.2% 11,765.72 11.2%
Employee benefit expenses as a % of revenues is same with respect to SAIL and RINL. The key difference is higher Iron ore prices for RINL Extracts from SAIL 2023-24 Annual report ## Raw Materials During the FY 2023-24, total requirement of iron ore was met from the captive sources. Your Company's captive mines produced about 34.34 million tonnes (MT) of iron ## Selling of Iron Ore from Captive Mines in Open Market About 1.16 MT of iron ore was made available in the open market from the Mines in the States of Odisha. Further, approval from Jharkhand State Government for selling of iron ore in the open market is still awaited. [^1]: Source – Annual reports of RINL and SAIL for financial year 2023-24
